goal: Add a permanent, self-contained regression check (Test-QueueRootDerivation.ps1) for Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1's QueueRoot path derivation, and prove it actually catches the specific bug fixed in trail fdd09c8b-6517-4858-a6d0-be15659aa649 rather than merely always passing.

steps.action: Author plugins/pmcro-reflector/skills/reflect-and-seed/scripts/Test-QueueRootDerivation.ps1: a deterministic, self-contained regression script (following this repo's existing Test-*.ps1 convention, e.g. Test-TrailLink.ps1) that mints two disposable scratch trails under a temp location via pmcro-trail's New-Trail.ps1, drives each through the minimal orchestrate->plan->make->check chain, then calls Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 once with an absolute custom -PmcroRoot and once with the default relative -PmcroRoot (CWD pushed to a scratch fake repo root), asserts (via Test-Path) that each queue item lands under the correct <root>/queue/ folder, always cleans up its own scratch artifacts (try/finally, even on failure), and exits 0 with a clear pass message or non-zero with a clear failure message naming which case broke.

Run the new script against the current, already-fixed Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 and confirm it exits 0/PASS. Then prove the check actually catches the regression it targets: make a temporary reverted copy of Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 (restoring the old buggy QueueRoot line from before trail fdd09c8b-6517-4858-a6d0-be15659aa649's fix) in a scratch location, point the new script at that reverted copy, and confirm it exits non-zero with a message identifying the broken case. Delete the reverted copy and all scratch artifacts afterward; leave the real Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 untouched throughout.

Independently re-run Test-QueueRootDerivation.ps1 against the real, current Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 and confirm exit 0. Independently reproduce the regression-catching case with a fresh temporary reverted copy and confirm non-zero exit. Confirm the real Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 file is unchanged from its fixed state, and search the repo (.pmcro/trails, .pmcro/queue, and the plugin's scripts/ folder) for any leftover scratch or reverted-copy artifacts. Append one CheckFrame with a PASS/FAIL verdict per criterion and overall.
Close the cycle: record a Reflection with a disposition reflecting whether a real, catches-the-bug regression check now exists for the QueueRoot derivation, then seal the trail.

success_criteria: plugins/pmcro-reflector/skills/reflect-and-seed/scripts/Test-QueueRootDerivation.ps1 exists, is self-contained (mints and cleans up its own scratch trails), and exits 0 with a clear pass message when run against the current, already-fixed Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1.

Running the new regression script against a deliberately-reverted copy of Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 (restoring the old buggy QueueRoot line) causes it to exit non-zero with a clear failure message identifying the broken case -- proving the check actually catches the regression it targets, not just a script that always exits 0.

No scratch trails, reverted-copy files, or other test artifacts created while building or exercising the new script remain anywhere in the repo (including .pmcro/trails, .pmcro/queue, and the plugin's own scripts/ folder) afterward.
The real plugins/pmcro-reflector/skills/reflect-and-seed/scripts/Complete-ReflectAndSeed.ps1 is unmodified (still contains the fix from trail fdd09c8b-6517-4858-a6d0-be15659aa649) after this cycle.

Adding regression checks for any other script in the colony -- scope is limited to the QueueRoot derivation bug just fixed.
